source.name: HIFLD Open 'Electric Substations' (last public release, re-hosted on ArcGIS Online item ef04dc8231c9491e804a008e5faa7d3a)
source.vintage: HIFLD Open Electric Substations, final public release before the 2022 move to HIFLD Secure (copy published 2022-02-14; max SOURCEDATE/VAL_DATE 2021-06-01)

fields.name: hifld_id
fields.description: HIFLD substation ID (source field ID). Primary key.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Substation name (source NAME). Many are synthetic 'UNKNOWNnnnnnn' or 'TAPnnnnnn' identifiers assigned by HIFLD.

fields.name: city
fields.description: City (source CITY).

fields.name: state
fields.description: Two-letter state abbreviation (source STATE).

fields.name: county
fields.description: County name (source COUNTY).

fields.name: zip
fields.description: ZIP code as text (source ZIP).

fields.name: type
fields.description: Facility type (source TYPE), e.g. SUBSTATION, TAP, RISER.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Operating status (source STATUS).

fields.name: naics_desc
fields.description: NAICS description (source NAICS_DESC).
enum: ELECTRIC BULK POWER TRANSMISSION AND CONTROL

fields.name: lines
fields.description: Number of HIFLD transmission lines connected (source LINES).

fields.name: max_volt_kv
fields.description: Maximum operating voltage (source MAX_VOLT); -999999 -> null. 53 records have MIN_VOLT > MAX_VOLT in the source (kept as-is); use max(max_volt_kv, min_volt_kv) for the highest voltage.

fields.name: min_volt_kv
fields.description: Minimum operating voltage (source MIN_VOLT); -999999 -> null. 53 records have MIN_VOLT > MAX_VOLT in the source (kept as-is); use max(max_volt_kv, min_volt_kv) for the highest voltage.

fields.name: max_infer
fields.description: True if max_volt_kv was inferred from connected lines rather than sourced (source MAX_INFER Y/N).

fields.name: min_infer
fields.description: True if min_volt_kv was inferred (source MIN_INFER Y/N).

fields.name: source
fields.description: Source reference (source SOURCE), usually a URL or imagery citation.

fields.name: sourcedate
fields.description: Date of source data (source SOURCEDATE, UTC).

fields.name: val_method
fields.description: Validation method (source VAL_METHOD).

fields.name: val_date
fields.description: Validation date (source VAL_DATE, UTC).

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude of the point geometry, WGS84, 6 decimals.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude of the point geometry, WGS84, 6 decimals.

fields.name: distance_mi
fields.description: Haversine distance (R=3958.8 mi) from Westminster High School (33.7538, -118.0111), 1 decimal.
